facts.fact: President Ellen Johnson Sirleaf signed the National Identification Registry Act into law on 1 August 2011, repealing Decree No. 65 and establishing the National Identification Registry, per the Liberian Observer.
The 2011 National Identification Registry Act mandated the NIR to design, establish, maintain and administer a National Biometric Identification System, per the Liberian Observer.

systems.owner: NIR, autonomous institution in the Executive Branch
